died.name: Cassian of Imola
died.cause: The pious schoolteacher was sentenced to death by Julian the Apostate and was handed over to his pupils to carry out the deed, which they did by binding him to a stake and stabbing him with their pens.

died.name: Dic Penderyn
died.cause: prior to execution by hanging for the non-fatal stabbing of a soldier during the Merthyr Rising. Another man confessed to the stabbing on his deathbed in 1874

died.name: Jack Cole
died.desc: American cartoonist, creator of Plastic Man
died.cause: in his suicide note to Hugh Hefner
died.last_words: Dear Hef, When you read this I shall be dead. I cannot go on living with myself and hurting those dear to me. What I do has nothing to do with you.

died.name: Hayato Ikeda
died.cause: a message to Kakuei Tanaka, former Secretary General of Liberal Democratic Party (Japan)
died.last_words: ″Front, your time and Kakuei Tanaka's era will come eventually. Politics must not be pampering to the people. I'll leave the rest to you.″

born.name: Alfred Hitchcock
born.last_words: One never knows the ending. One has to die to know exactly what happens after death, although Catholics have their hopes.

born.name: Bill Masterton
born.cause: after sustaining fatal head injury in NHL game
